entries.title: Psalms 113:1
segments: ¶Let the Lord be praised. O you servants of the Lord, give praise to the name of the Lord.

entries.title: Psalms 113:2
segments: Let blessing be on the name of the Lord, from this time and for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 113:3
segments: From the coming up of the sun to its going down, the Lord's name is to be praised.

entries.title: Psalms 113:4
segments: The Lord is high over all nations, and his glory is higher than the heavens.

entries.title: Psalms 113:5
segments: Who is like the Lord our God, who is seated on high,

entries.title: Psalms 113:6
segments: Looking down on the heavens, and on the earth?

entries.title: Psalms 113:7
segments: He takes the poor man out of the dust, lifting him up from his low position;

entries.title: Psalms 113:8
segments: To give him a place among the rulers, even with the rulers of his people.

entries.title: Psalms 113:9
segments: He gives the unfertile woman a family, making her a happy mother of children. Give praise to the Lord.
